title: Rudrapur, Barhaj, Bhatpar Rani Me Blood Test Ghar Par
description: Deoria Sadar, Rudrapur, Barhaj, Salempur, Bhatpar Rani aur Lar me ghar par blood test — kis ilaake me kis mausam kaunsi jaanch, aur report doctor tak kaise.
keywords: Home sample collection in Deoria Sadar
Deoria mein blood test at home
takeaways: Deoria jile ki paanch tehsil — Sadar, Rudrapur, Barhaj, Salempur aur Bhatpar Rani — me service ek hi hai, lekin har taraf ki zaroorat alag hai: kahin nadi aur baadh, kahin Bihar ki seema, kahin Gorakhpur ki OPD.
Rate ilaake ke hisaab se nahi badalta, aur ghar se sample lene ka koi alag charge nahi judta — Sadar me bhi nahi, Lar ya Bhatpar Rani me bhi nahi.

Barhaj ya Rudrapur me "diagnostic center" dhoondh rahe hain to ek baat saaf jaan lijiye: blood aur urine ki routine jaanch ghar par ho jaati hai, lekin X-ray, ultrasound aur ECG hamari service nahi hain.
Doctor chahe Deoria me ho, Gorakhpur me, Mau me ya Siwan me — report PDF me phone par aati hai, isliye sample ghar par dijiye aur report wahan bhejiye jahan ilaaj chal raha hai.

note.title: Har jagah wahi paanch baatein
note.text: Deoria jile me jahan bhi sample liya jaata hai, wahan ye paanch baatein ek jaisi hain: home collection free, trained phlebotomist ID card ke saath, slot subah 6 baje se, report 24 ghante ke andar, aur payment sample ke waqt cash ya UPI se. Iske alawa koi daawa hum nahi karte.

sections.heading: Home Sample Collection In Deoria Sadar — Sheher Me Dikkat Doori Nahi, Samay Hai
sections.lead: Office, kacheri aur school ke beech khaali pet line me lagna sabse bhaari padta hai.
blocks: Deoria Sadar me aspatal aur clinic paas hain, isliye yahan ghar par sample ki zaroorat doori ki wajah se nahi, samay ki wajah se padti hai. Subah office ya kacheri jaana hai, bachchon ko school chhodna hai, dukaan kholni hai — aur fasting wala test ho to naashta tab tak ruka rehta hai jab tak line khatam na ho. Home sample collection in Deoria Sadar isi chakkar ko kaat deta hai: 6 baje ke slot me sample, turant naashta, aur din apne samay par.

list: Naukri wale — fasting wala test subah 6 se 7 ke slot me rakhiye; office ka samay nahi bigadta.
Bujurg jo akele rehte hain aur bachche bahar hain — booking bahar se bhi ho sakti hai; mobile number ghar ke kisi aise vyakti ka dijiye jo darwaza khol sake.
Gorakhpur ki OPD ka din tay hai — ek-do din pehle Deoria me sample de dijiye, taaki report phone par saath jaaye aur wahan ek din bache.
Bistar par pade mareez — sample bistar par hi liya jaata hai; bas booking ke waqt bata dijiye.

blocks: Ek imaandar baat bhi. Zila aspatal me bahut si jaanch muft ya kam kharche me hoti hai, aur jinke paas samay hai unke liye wo raasta hamesha khula hai. Ghar par sample un logon ke liye hai jinke liye din ka nuksaan, bheed, ya mareez ko le jaana mushkil hai.

Agar pichhli baar ke parche par wahi test dobara karane ko likha hai, to OPD se ek-do din pehle Rudrapur me hi ghar par sample de dijiye. Report PDF me phone par aa jaati hai, aur doctor ke saamne ek hi visit me baat ho jaati hai.

list: Barsaat ke mahine — bukhar ke mareez ke liye CBC, malaria aur din ke hisaab se dengue ya typhoid; dast ke saath stool routine.
Gorakhpur OPD se pehle — parche me likhi follow-up jaanch, jaise HbA1c, KFT, LFT ya CBC.

faqs.question: Rudrapur ya Barhaj me ghar par blood test ka rate Deoria Sadar se alag hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Rate ilaake ke hisaab se nahi badalta, aur ghar se sample lene ka koi alag visiting ya travel charge nahi judta. Har test ka rate Deoria ki price list me likha hai, aur payment sample lene ke waqt cash ya UPI se hota hai.

faqs.question: Barhaj me aapka diagnostic center ya collection counter kahan hai?
faqs.answer: Barhaj me hamara koi walk-in centre ya counter nahi hai. Blood, urine aur stool ki routine jaanch ka sample ghar par liya jaata hai. X-ray, ultrasound, ECG, CT ya MRI hamari service nahi hain — unke liye imaging centre ya aspatal jaana hoga.

faqs.question: Bhatpar Rani me rehte hain aur doctor Siwan me dikhate hain — report wahan chalegi?
faqs.answer: Report WhatsApp aur email par PDF me aati hai, jise aap kisi bhi doctor ko forward kar sakte hain. Report maanna ya na maanna doctor ka faisla hai, isliye pehli baar unse pooch lijiye. Follow-up chal raha ho to har baar ek hi lab se test karaiye, taaki number ki tulna sahi ho.

faqs.question: Salempur me rehte hain — booking Deoria ke page se karein ya Salempur ke?
faqs.answer: Salempur tehsil aur uske aas-paas ke gaon ke liye Salempur ka apna page aur form hai. Wahin se booking kijiye, taaki aapka gaon sahi ilaake me gina jaaye. Rate aur service ki paanch baatein dono jagah ek jaisi hain.

faqs.question: Lar ke paas ke gaon me rehte hain, gaon ka naam soochi me nahi hai — kya sample liya jaayega?
faqs.answer: Soochi me sirf bade kasbon ke naam hain; aas-paas ke gaon aksar cover hote hain. Booking se pehle ek call kar lijiye — cover hota hai to usi call par slot tay ho jaata hai, aur nahi hota to saaf bata diya jaata hai.

faqs.question: Gorakhpur me OPD hai — test Rudrapur me ghar par karayein ya Gorakhpur me?
faqs.answer: Agar parche par pehle se follow-up test likha hai, to OPD se ek-do din pehle ghar par sample de dijiye. Report phone par aa jaati hai aur doctor ke saamne ek hi visit me baat ho jaati hai. Doctor ne nayi jaanch likhi ho ya scan likha ho, to wo wahin ki planning se hogi.

faqs.question: Baadh me raasta band hai — kya us din sample lene koi aayega?
faqs.answer: Ye us din ke raaste par tay hota hai. Booking ke waqt apne gaon ki haalat bata dijiye; hum saaf bata denge ki visit ho paayegi ya nahi. Mareez ki haalat gambhir ho to intezaar mat kijiye — najdeeki aspatal le jaaiye.
